terms.summary: Conditional attack buff and debuff removal; each of the two selected allies uses targetHpBelow50 to choose active healing below 50% or the critical-damage buff at 50% and above. One heal event preserves all eligible recipients.
Three-target magic damage; after damage, emits one activeSkillHeal event targeting the first lineup ally under the full-HP tie convention. Enemy buff removal and healing amounts are ignored.
Critical chance has no effect in the fixed-critical model.
Regeneration and HP-dependent behavior are outside the fixed-full-HP model.
